summary: Retest of two bugs from iteration_1 (Honor Hall + Records-Player season selectors not refreshing data). Both bugs are FIXED. The `data-sveltekit-reload` attribute on the <form id="filters"> element correctly forces a full navigation and re-runs the +page.server.js load function on dropdown change.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: `data-sveltekit-reload` on the form forces a full document navigation on GET submit, which re-runs +page.server.js. No regressions observed.

Optional consistency improvement: other season-selector pages (Standings, Matchups, Records-Team) use a different working pattern. Consider standardising all selectors on a single approach for maintainability (not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_1 bugs are resolved. Only retested the two reported flows as per main agent instructions; other flows (Home, Rosters, Standings, Matchups, Records-Team, Admin, mobile menu, sticky header) were not retouched per request.
rca of the issue: Original bug: GET <form> submission inside a SvelteKit client-routed page did not re-invoke +page.server.js load when only query string changed. Fix: adding `data-sveltekit-reload` instructs SvelteKit's router to perform a full-document navigation on form submission, which guarantees the load function executes with the new ?season=YYYY value. Verified end-to-end via Playwright: dropdown change -> URL update -> SSR data update -> UI re-render with correct season-specific data.
